purpose: Teach: 輪廻/撃沈/怒涛/凱旋/建立/警備隊/生まれつき/オウム真理教

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、輪廻のような長期ビジョンを持て
lines.en: Our company must have a long-term vision as enduring as a cycle of rebirth.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Sits forward slightly. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. The tone of someone used to being listened to without needing to raise his voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。撃沈されないように事業を多角化します
lines.en: Yes. We'll diversify our business so we don't sink.
lines.style: Respectful and focused. Nods slightly on the affirmation. Speaking to be clear, not to impress. Steady eye contact, professional distance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、怒涛の勢いで新市場に挑め
lines.en: Our company must charge into new markets with unstoppable momentum.
lines.style: Sharper attack than before. Leans in with quiet intensity. The cadence quickens slightly—urgency masked by composure. Almost a command dressed as vision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業成績の凱旋報告を社員集会で行います
lines.en: Yes. I'll report our sales victories at the next all-hands meeting.
lines.style: Affirmative and efficient. Straightens up. Speaking as someone who knows exactly what the next step is and is ready to take it. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新拠点を建立し業界の中心に立て
lines.en: Our company must build a new headquarters and stake our claim at the center of the industry.
lines.style: Declarative, almost architectural in precision. Each phrase a building block. Low, steady voice—the tone of someone who sees the future already built.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員用警備隊との連携を強化します
lines.en: Yes. I'll strengthen our coordination with the security team.
lines.style: Clipped, professional affirmation. Brief and capable. The response of someone taking mental notes and filing them away. Efficient, not cold.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、生まれつきの障害を持つ社員も活躍できる職場にしろ
lines.en: Our company must become a workplace where employees with disabilities from birth can thrive and contribute.
lines.style: Softer attack, but no less firm. The voice widens slightly—this matters differently. Not performing compassion, but speaking from principle. Deliberate pace, almost gentle but unwavering.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。オウム真理教事件の教訓を社員研修に活かします
lines.en: Yes. I'll integrate the lessons from the Aum Shinrikyo incident into our employee training.
lines.style: Serious, measured. The gravity of the reference lands clearly. Quiet, respectful tone—this is not routine business. Speaking carefully, acknowledging what needs to be said and said well.
